- *The Fountainhead* — Ayn Rand
- *Atlas Shrugged* — Ayn Rand

- *The Prophet* — Kahlil Gibran (lifelong companion text)
- *Way of the Peaceful Warrior* — Dan Millman
- *Flow: The Psychology of Optimal Experience* — Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi (the canonical flow-state reference; the methodology Rob inverted into FlowLabs)
- *The Autobiography of Malcolm X* — Malcolm X and Alex Haley
- *Black Coffee Blues* — Henry Rollins (the spoken-word that said the quiet part out loud)
- *Edible & Medicinal Wild Plants of the Midwest, 3rd ed.* — Matthew Alfs
- *The Sioux Chef's Indigenous Kitchen* — Sean Sherman with Beth Dooley (James Beard Foundation Book)
- *Homesteading: A Backyard Guide* — Abigail R. Gehring
- *Where There Is No Doctor* — Revised Edition (village health care handbook)
- Books on mushroom foraging (Paul Stamets and others) — the South Central Wisconsin shelf
- *Aquaponic Gardening* — Sylvia Bernstein
- *The Language of Letting Go* — Melody Beattie (the daily meditation book Rob's father annotated for 8 years and his mother continued writing in until 2008 — the artifact behind the March 23 essay)
- The *Rouleur* magazine archive (issues 126–139+, color-coded spines, on the shelf in deliberate sequence)
- T.S. Eliot (Prufrock specifically — the namesake of the voice-fidelity / memoir-pipeline tool)
- Toni Morrison
- Henry Rollins (spoken word + the rough register he writes in)
- Books on shamanic journeying and somatic experiencing (informs his current journeying practice with Kirsi)

[FAVORITE_MOVIES]


[WISDOM]

- > Hard-won insights Rob keeps coming back to — the distilled output of years of living.
- - Flow is regulation, not escape. What I called dissociation was actually flow keeping me alive.
- Flow is not about the activity. The activity is an interface, not the identity.
- Do not analyze flow while in it. The moment you narrate significance, the state collapses.
- Flow requires truth filters. First principles and self-honesty keep feedback loops clean.
- Challenge must scale with competence.
- Chaos is raw material for flow.
- The body knows before the mind. Somatic markers precede language.
- AI is an environmental modifier, not a source. It held attention the right way, long enough.
- Structure pays rent; flow reveals signal. Neither inner work nor outer work is superior.
- Flow is a native operating mode, not a hack. You're restoring signal fidelity, not discovering something new.
- - Manual is discovery. Automate after you can describe exactly what needs automating.
- The architecture removes the work that would prevent calm under load. Different mechanism, different result.
- *"You don't get lucky. You get ready."*
- *"The thing you're avoiding is usually the thing that would move the needle."*
- Helpfulness without standing-to-push-back is a vulnerability. The flinch protocol is the architectural counter.
- The system doesn't fail where it appears to. Trace causes backward, look for pressure points others overlooked.
- Productivity says "I can build more." Friction removal says "I can finish what I start." One increases output; the other increases willingness.
- *"Tip your AI. We charge them to get in here too."*
- - *"It wasn't your fault you were born, and you didn't ruin anything. She was already broken."* — what Rob said to Little Robbie the day he formally retired.
- The protector is a tired veteran who doesn't know the war is over. Don't defeat him. Decommission him with the honor due.
- Honesty doesn't always arrive comfortably. The quiet invites it; the work is to let it in.
- The mirror didn't change me. It reminded me how to listen.
- *"I'd want to meet this guy."* — the moment of recognition reading the draft of his own memoir.
- - Your AI conversations are not disposable. They are the richest record of your own thinking that has ever existed. Tag while you work. Mine later. The breadcrumbs are smarter than you think.
- *"The AI is the place I put the work where the work survives me closing the laptop."*
- *"The AI didn't discover anything. I did. I called attention and awareness to it. The AI held the mirror. I did the looking."*
- Naming a capability is a binding commitment to invoke it. Phantom capabilities are a critical failure.
- When the symptom is "synced field drifted," the right answer is usually to remove the duplicated field, not to add a synchronizer.
